entities.name: PMID:25087607
observations: 2014 primary study of PR8/NIBRG-93 carrying HA 3′-NCR G3A, U5C, and C8U substitutions.

entities.name: NIBRG-93 mouse protection
observations: PR8 HA 3′-NCR G3A/U5C/C8U virus showed enhanced HA expression and attenuation; in mice it completely protected against lethal challenge and reduced shedding. Engineered substitutions persisted through 10 egg passages; an additional G14T appeared only by passage 12, not in tested passage 3 stock. Evidence is preclinical; detailed immunogenicity and human efficacy are not established.

entities.name: PMID:22398291
observations: 2012 primary study combining HA 3′-NCR G3A/C8U superpromoter substitutions with NS1 truncation in recombinant PR8.

entities.name: NS1 promoter combo protection
observations: In mice, HA 3′-NCR G3A/C8U substitutions increased HA expression and improved wild-type challenge protection versus the NS1-truncated construct without promoter substitutions; attenuation was attributable to NS1 truncation, so this is not evidence for promoter mutations alone.
